-- Create test customer user
INSERT INTO users (name, email, role, userType, createdAt, updatedAt, lastSignedIn)
VALUES ('Test Customer', 'testcustomer@styleswap.local', 'user', 'customer', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  updatedAt = NOW(),
  lastSignedIn = NOW()
RETURNING id, email, name, role, userType;
